statement: With CONFIG_JOYSTICK_XPAD_FF xpad registers EV_FF/FF_RUMBLE via memless input FF, translates strong/weak to 8-byte 00 08 output on wired 360, and sends through its USB output queue. Existence of EV_FF on a separate uinput virtual device proves only the virtual consumer endpoint, not xpad USB/physical rumble transport.

applicability.revision: pinned community Free60 ab1fe19, protoR2 4c0d062, x360w a8ac630; Linux 4056b3c; SDL 535d80b and 829a65d; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: xpad.c 1542-1580, 1627-1639, 2032-2034. uinput FF callbacks must be explicitly realized and handled by the virtual provider.
